{{Quote|If I did everything ''right'', our ''de-icing system'' should now be drawing power from the ''main reactor''--|Han Solo|<ref name="MSW28" />}}
A '''de-icing system''' was normally used to heat the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], defrosting any ice that had accumulated there. When the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was being attacked by a swarm of [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] rigged up [[conversion module]]s to connect the de-icing system to the main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]], causing the hull to heat up enough to scorch off the mites. This quickly began to tax the conversion modules, and blew them out.<ref name="MSW28" />
